About

I’m Roberto Pérez, a Bay Area photographer with over a decade of experience documenting meaningful moments.

Since 2013 I’ve specialized in weddings, family portraits, maternity, and graduations throughout the San Francisco Bay Area and Central Valley. My approach is light, natural, and focused on authentic connection. When you work with me, you can expect high-quality imagery and a seamless, professional experience from first inquiry to final delivery. Se habla español.
